page.overview:
Who is Planeswalker War?

The Planeswalker War was a tremendous, yet mysterious war that took place on Corondor, concluding in 4196 AR.

The war was triggered by Ravidel, who led a group of planeswalkers to the island of Corondor by activating the Mox Beacon in 3980 AR.

Jared Carthalion was able to lead a small group of heroes to victory in the war. Other known survivors include Leshrac, Tevesh Szat, Kristina, and Geyadrone Dihada.

Victims of the war were Ash Warlod Embereck, who was killed by Ravidel, and Grenfell Mor, killed by Sandruu. It's also possible that Ravidel himself died, but his ultimate fate is unclear.
